title: Deriving Semantic Checkers from Tests to Detect Silent Failures in Production Distributed Systems
problem: Silent failures in distributed systems (partial failures, state inconsistencies) aren't caught by standard testing, causing production outages
motivation: Reliable distributed systems are critical for AI infrastructure; automated detection of silent failures improves system trustworthiness
method: Automated derivation of semantic checkers from existing test cases to detect violations in production
key_novelty: First approach to systematically derive semantic checkers from test cases for production failure detection
contributions: Automated semantic checker generation from tests
Detection of silent failures in production
limitations: Title-only paper; automation quality and coverage not specified; false positive/negative rates unknown
